name: badge
useFor: Use the default Fog tag for a value that describes a site (345 kV, 41.2 ac, Zone X, I-2 Industrial). Use variant="outline" with a BadgeMark for a record's state: state="verified" (solid diamond), "loading" (three bars) or "queued" (outlined diamond). Use inverse for a tag on a map or photo, count for a small number beside a label, and success, warning or destructive only when the colour carries a verdict (Passes, Partial data, In a flood zone).
constraints: A cut corner on a badge
More than one inverse badge in a row
title: Badge
description: Square 24px tags and statuses: Fog data tags for site values, the Forest inverse tag, and the Bone status pill led by a diamond (Verified, Loading, Queued).
